+# Get ACR docker env credential helper. This builds OUR patched copy, which
+# lives in this repo as ordinary packages of the kaniko module under
+# GO-2026-6225 hostname check fixed; see PATCHES.md there). There is no go.mod
+# replace and no upstream module involved. -mod=vendor stops Go resolving
+# anything from the network. The binary name is unchanged.
+# Guard (GO-2026-6225): fail the build unless the helper's build info shows it
+# is the in-tree package and that no github.com/chrismellard module was linked
+# in. This reads the binary's build info rather than running it, so it works
+# whatever the target arch (buildx emulation or a cross-compiled binary).
+      echo "ERROR: docker-credential-acr-env is not the patched in-tree copy (third_party/docker-credential-acr-env)." >&2; \
+      echo "It may ship the unpatched upstream helper (GO-2026-6225: ACR token leak to lookalike hosts)." >&2; \
+# Functional check (GO-2026-6225), only when the binary can run on the build
+# host: a lookalike ACR host must be answered with "credentials not found"
+# before any token request. The lookalike uses the reserved .invalid TLD and
+# AZURE_ENVIRONMENT is set to a non-existent cloud, so even an unpatched helper
+# fails before any network or token request instead of leaking a token from
+RUN if [ "$(go env GOHOSTARCH)" = "$(go env GOARCH)" ] && [ "$(go env GOHOSTOS)" = "$(go env GOOS)" ]; then \
+      out="$(printf 'evil.azurecr.io.example.invalid' | env -i HOME=/tmp AZURE_ENVIRONMENT=no-such-cloud /usr/local/bin/docker-credential-acr-env get 2>&1 || true)"; \
+        *) echo "ERROR: docker-credential-acr-env did not reject a lookalike ACR host (GO-2026-6225)." >&2; exit 1 ;; \
+      echo "Skipping docker-credential-acr-env functional check: cross-compiled for $(go env GOOS)/$(go env GOARCH)."; \

+// patchedACRHelper is the import path of the patched in-tree ACR helper
+// isolateACRHelper makes sure the ACR helper can never reach the network in
+// these tests, even if an unpatched helper were linked instead. The unpatched
+// upstream helper accepts lookalike hosts and goes on to read its Azure
+// settings; an invalid AZURE_ENVIRONMENT makes that fail before any token
+// request, so the test fails with a non "not found" error rather than calling
+// Azure. The patched helper rejects the host before reading any settings.
+// TestGetKeychainUsesPatchedACRHelper fails if creds.go stops importing the
+// patched in-tree ACR helper (for example if it goes back to
+// by reading creds.go's imports because a behavioural check through
+// GetKeychain cannot tell the helpers apart: authn.NewKeychainFromHelper turns
+			t.Errorf("creds.go imports the unpatched upstream ACR helper %q (GO-2026-6225)", path)
+		t.Errorf("creds.go does not import the patched ACR helper %q", patchedACRHelper)
+// TestACRHelperIsPatched checks the in-tree helper rejects lookalike hosts
+// with "credentials not found" before any token request.
+			t.Errorf("ACR helper Get(%q): err = %v, want credentials not found", h, err)
+Upstream has been unmaintained since 2023 and has no fix for GO-2026-6225, so
+It is an in-module copy: these are ordinary packages of the kaniko module
+There is no separate `go.mod`, no `replace` directive, and the upstream module
+path no longer appears in kaniko's `go.mod`, `vendor/` or build info. It is
+- `pkg/creds`, which links `pkg/credhelper` into the executor and warmer
+licence (Apache-2.0) and upstream copyright headers are kept.
+1. GO-2026-6225: `pkg/credhelper/helper.go` replaces the unanchored host regex
+   with an anchored, label-aware check (`isACRRegistry`): exact `host[:port]`
+   only, valid port range, no trailing dot, no malformed labels, still
+   case-sensitive. Non-ACR hosts now get a "credentials not found" error from
+   `Get` rather than a generic error. Tests are in
+   cobra, viper, docker-credential-helpers and so on) come from kaniko's own
+   `go.mod`, so there is no separate dependency list to keep up to date.
+Every local code change to the helper logic is marked with a
+`Chainguard patch` comment. To review them, diff this directory against the
+upstream commit above (ignoring the import path rewrite).
+Ownership: because the upstream module path is gone, vulnerability databases
+will not match any future advisory filed against
+maintains this fork should watch for such advisories and apply them here.
+long-term destination (it carries the full upstream history and fixed
+GO-2026-6225), but as of 2026-10-26 it is not a drop-in for this repository.
+v1.0.0 (2026-10-25) requires `go 1.27.0` while kaniko is on Go 1.26 in
+`go.mod`, CI and the builder image. v0.8.0 is Go 1.26 compatible and closest to
+upstream behaviour, but from v0.9.0 the fork adds an azidentity auth path behind
+`FF_DOCKER_ACR_AZIDENTITY` (on by default in v1.0.0), which is a bigger
+behavioural change than a credential-leak fix should carry. Its host check is
+anchored but coarser than ours (no label validation, no `Host == input` guard).
+Revisit when kaniko moves to Go 1.27, if we want advisory matching back.

+// Chainguard patch (GO-2026-6225): upstream's acrRE was unanchored, so any
+// "evil.azurecr.io.attacker.com") was treated as ACR and sent an Azure AD
+// derived token. acrHostRE is anchored at both ends and only admits
+// well-formed lower-case DNS labels in front of an ACR domain.
+// portRE matches the digits of an explicit port; the range is checked separately.
+// isACRRegistry reports whether input is a bare ACR or MCR registry host,
+//   - input must be exactly host[:port]. url.Parse splits userinfo, path,
+//     query and fragment off before Host and decodes percent-escapes in
+//     Hostname(), so the Host == input comparison is load-bearing: it is the
+//     only thing that rejects inputs such as "[::1%25.azurecr.io]" or
+//     "foo%C3%A9.azurecr.io", whose decoded Hostname() would otherwise look
+//   - an explicit port must be 1-65535 (an empty port, as in "host:", is
+//   - the hostname must be mcr.microsoft.com, or match acrHostRE: anchored,
+//     no trailing dot, no empty or malformed labels.
+//   - matching is case-sensitive, as it was upstream. Registry hosts are
+//     normally lower case; widening to mixed case would change what is
+//     forwarded to the token exchange, so it is deliberately not done here.
+		if n, err := strconv.Atoi(port); err != nil || n < 1 || n > 65535 {
+		// Chainguard patch: report "credentials not found" rather than a
+		// generic error, so that docker/cli and go-containerregistry treat a
+		// non-ACR host as anonymous when this binary is used as a global
+		// credsStore, instead of failing the whole lookup.
+		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("failed to acquire sp token %w", err)
+		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("failed to acquire refresh token %w", err)

+// TestIsACRHelper tests whether URLs are detected as being ACR/MCR registry
+// hosts, to determine whether the cred helper should fail fast.
+// Rows marked "Chainguard" were added with the GO-2026-6225 patch.
+		// Chainguard: legitimate hosts that must keep working.
+		// Chainguard: userinfo, path, query and fragment forms. url.Parse

+		// Chainguard: percent-encoded hosts. Hostname() decodes these into

+		// Host == input check is what rejects them.
+		// Chainguard: matching stays case-sensitive, as upstream was.
